## 02 - EGX Historical Import

One-time (or periodic re-backfill) import of ~HISTORICAL_DAYS trading sessions per active stock. Batches requests (API_BATCH_SIZE) with a delay between batches (API_DELAY_MS) to respect provider rate limits. A single bad symbol is logged to `workflow_errors` and does NOT stop the import.

Run 01-egx-stock-universe first so `stocks` is populated.

### ⚠️ CONFIGURE BEFORE USE

Edit the HTTP Request node's URL to your provider's documented EOD/historical candles endpoint. This node deliberately ships with a placeholder path — see docs/DATA_PROVIDER.md for the normalization contract the Normalize node expects (date/open/high/low/close/volume in some form).

parameters.query: SELECT id, symbol, $1 AS market FROM stocks WHERE exchange = $1 AND active = TRUE ORDER BY symbol;

INSERT INTO daily_prices (stock_id, trading_date, open, high, low, close, volume, traded_value)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8)
ON CONFLICT (stock_id, trading_date) DO UPDATE SET
  open = EXCLUDED.open, high = EXCLUDED.high, low = EXCLUDED.low, close = EXCLUDED.close,
  volume = EXCLUDED.volume, traded_value = EXCLUDED.traded_value, updated_at = now();

INSERT INTO workflow_errors (workflow_name, symbol, trading_date, error_message, payload)
VALUES ('02-egx-historical-import', $1, $2, $3, $4::jsonb);
SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS total_daily_price_rows FROM daily_prices;
